title: Models and Costumes for Dinosaur Boulevard
content: The kid rolling the Hula Hoop across the parking lot was a neighbor wearing a castoff opera costume.We made the robe for the Stegosaurus traffic helper out of muslin, and we painted black and red diamonds on it with acrylic paint.Our store has got some large, lusciousart printsofDinosaur Boulevardthat you can frame and hang up in your place of honor to proclaim yourself as a true Dinotopian.
